description: Na₂Zr(WO₄)₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent WO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 61°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.72 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent WO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 55°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.43 Å. Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent WO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-61°. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.17 Å. There are three inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-2.46 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-55°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.04 Å. In the third W site, W is bonded to four O atoms to form WO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra and corners with six NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-74°. There are two shorter (1.78 Å) and two longer (1.86 Å) W-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zr and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Zr and two W atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one W atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two W atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one W atom.
